reason: In header.hbs:6-95 the `{{header-extra-info}}` block comes after `.panel` in the markup, and the patch moves it in front visually with `order(2)` (topic.scss:30) and `order(3)` (header.scss `.panel`). Moving the block above `.panel` gives the same layout, since `.panel`'s `margin-left: auto` still pushes it right, so the order mixin and both calls aren't needed. As written, Tab reaches the panel buttons before the extra-info links, the reverse of what users see (the old float layout had the same mismatch).
